title: Macbook Scroll
description: A CSS-drawn laptop pins in place and opens its lid as the screenshot scales up.

a11y.motion: The laptop renders open with the screenshot at full size, the section drops its extra scroll height, and nothing moves while scrolling.
a11y.screenReader: The title is an h2 and the screenshot uses the `alt` you pass (empty by default); the lid shell, keyboard and trackpad are aria-hidden.

examples.name: dashboard
examples.title: Custom screen
examples.description: A mock dashboard built from Tailwind as the screen content instead of an image.
